verdict.rationale: Polar has no user-configurable rules engine. What it offers is event-driven webhooks with typed payloads, SDK validation helpers and built-in Slack/Discord formatting, so users can route events to their own code or chat channels. Its automatic behaviors (renewals, dunning retries, usage metering) run on fixed platform logic rather than rules the user defines. Missing for 10: a native rule/workflow builder for event-to-action automations, user-defined conditions and actions without custom webhook handlers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
